zh.tagline: 多模型天气比较，按地块提醒
zh.description: 不同的天气模型，预报常常不一样。CompareCast 把几个模型的预报和实际下雨量放在一起比较，告诉你哪个模型在你的园地最准，还可以为每个地块设定下雨提醒。

en.tagline: Multi-model weather comparison with per-plot reminders
en.description: Different weather models often disagree. CompareCast puts several models next to the rain that actually fell, shows which one is most accurate for your farm, and lets you set rain reminders for each plot.
features: Forecast vs actual rain
Several weather models side by side
Wind gust map, to prepare for broken branches
MetMalaysia radar: see where rain is falling now
Rain reminders for each plot

features: Ramalan vs hujan sebenar
Bandingkan beberapa model cuaca
Peta angin kencang, elak dahan patah
Radar MetMalaysia: lihat di mana hujan sedang turun
Peringatan hujan mengikut plot

zh.tagline: 厄尔尼诺监测，看懂马来西亚的干旱和烟霾风险
zh.description: 厄尔尼诺一来，园里会不会旱、会不会有烟霾？SUHU 汇集 NOAA、澳洲气象局等机构的厄尔尼诺（ENSO）、印度洋偶极子（IOD）和 MJO 监测数据，翻译成半岛、沙巴和砂拉越的干旱、烟霾和洪水风险。它不是另一个预报，而是帮你读懂官方数据。数据每 6 小时自动更新，可以安装到手机，离线也能看。
features: 一眼看懂现在是厄尔尼诺、拉尼娜还是中性
半岛东西海岸、沙巴、砂拉越的区域风险
苏门答腊、加里曼丹火点数，烟霾提前预警
按地点看空气质量（PM2.5）、体感温度和紫外线
MJO 未来 1–2 周偏干还是偏湿

en.tagline: El Niño monitor: what it means for drought and haze in Malaysia
en.description: When El Niño arrives, will your farm go dry, and will the haze come? SUHU gathers El Niño (ENSO), Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD) and MJO monitoring from NOAA, Australia's Bureau of Meteorology and others, and turns it into drought, haze and flood risk for the Peninsula, Sabah and Sarawak. It is not another forecast; it helps you read the official data. Data refreshes every 6 hours, and the app installs on your phone and works offline.
features: See at a glance: El Niño, La Niña or neutral
Risk for the Peninsula west and east coasts, Sabah and Sarawak
Fire hotspot counts in Sumatra and Kalimantan, an early haze warning
Air quality (PM2.5), feels-like temperature and UV for your location
MJO outlook: drier or wetter in the next 1–2 weeks

ms.tagline: Pemantau El Niño: risiko kemarau dan jerebu di Malaysia
ms.description: Bila El Niño datang, adakah kebun anda akan kering, dan adakah jerebu akan tiba? SUHU kumpulkan data pemantauan El Niño (ENSO), Dipol Lautan Hindi (IOD) dan MJO daripada NOAA, Biro Meteorologi Australia dan lain-lain, lalu terjemahkan kepada risiko kemarau, jerebu dan banjir untuk Semenanjung, Sabah dan Sarawak. Ia bukan ramalan baharu; ia bantu anda faham data rasmi. Data dikemas kini setiap 6 jam, dan aplikasi boleh dipasang di telefon serta digunakan tanpa internet.
features: Lihat sekilas: El Niño, La Niña atau neutral
Risiko untuk pantai barat dan timur Semenanjung, Sabah dan Sarawak
Bilangan titik panas di Sumatera dan Kalimantan, amaran awal jerebu
Kualiti udara (PM2.5), suhu terasa dan UV mengikut lokasi
Tinjauan MJO: lebih kering atau basah dalam 1–2 minggu

features: NDVI 作物长势图
NDMI 水分指数
生产力分区
地块当地天气

en.tagline: Sentinel-2 satellite view of crop growth, moisture and weather for each plot
en.description: Uses Sentinel-2 satellite images to work out a plant health index (NDVI) and a moisture index (NDMI), find the weaker spots, and show local weather for the plot. No more guessing on field rounds; go straight to where it matters.
features: NDVI crop growth map
NDMI moisture index
Productivity zones
Local weather for the plot

ms.tagline: Satelit Sentinel-2 untuk lihat tumbesaran, kelembapan dan cuaca setiap plot
ms.description: Guna imej satelit Sentinel-2 untuk kira indeks tumbuhan (NDVI) dan indeks kelembapan (NDMI), cari kawasan yang lemah, dan lihat cuaca setempat plot. Tak perlu meneka lagi, terus pergi ke tempat yang paling perlu.
features: Peta tumbesaran tanaman NDVI
Indeks kelembapan NDMI
Zon produktiviti
Cuaca setempat plot

zh.tagline: 给果园看的厄尔尼诺、季风和 MJO 监测
zh.description: 直接读 NOAA 的 RONI 和每周 Niño 3.4 数据，告诉你现在是厄尔尼诺、拉尼娜还是中性，再加上印度洋偶极子（IOD）、MJO 和东北季风寒潮。每一项都附上对果园的意思：要防旱、顾排水，还是先别喷药。官方暴雨和水灾警报请看 MetMalaysia。
features: RONI 官方指数和每周 Niño 3.4 海温
印度洋偶极子（IOD）和 MJO 对本地降雨的影响
东北季风寒潮提醒：1–3 天大雨
按季风季节给果园工作建议
直接连到 MetMalaysia 官方警报

en.tagline: El Niño, monsoon and MJO monitor for orchards
en.description: Reads NOAA's RONI and weekly Niño 3.4 data to show whether we are in El Niño, La Niña or neutral, then adds the Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), the MJO and Northeast Monsoon surges. Each one comes with what it means for the orchard: guard against drought, prepare drainage, or hold off spraying. For official heavy-rain and flood warnings, it points you to MetMalaysia.
features: RONI official index and weekly Niño 3.4 sea temperature
Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD) and MJO effect on local rain
Northeast Monsoon surge alerts: 1–3 days of heavy rain
Orchard advice for each monsoon season
Links straight to MetMalaysia official warnings

ms.name: Pemantau ENSO
ms.tagline: Pemantau El Niño, monsun dan MJO untuk dusun
ms.description: Membaca data RONI dan Niño 3.4 mingguan NOAA untuk tunjuk sama ada kita dalam El Niño, La Niña atau neutral, kemudian tambah Dipol Lautan Hindi (IOD), MJO dan luruan Monsun Timur Laut. Setiap satu disertakan maksudnya untuk dusun: berjaga dengan kemarau, sediakan saliran, atau tangguhkan semburan. Untuk amaran rasmi hujan lebat dan banjir, ia bawa anda ke MetMalaysia.
features: Indeks rasmi RONI dan suhu laut Niño 3.4 mingguan
Kesan Dipol Lautan Hindi (IOD) dan MJO pada hujan tempatan
Amaran luruan Monsun Timur Laut: 1–3 hari hujan lebat
Nasihat dusun untuk setiap musim monsun
Pautan terus ke amaran rasmi MetMalaysia

zh.tagline: 大气垂直剖面，判断今天会不会有雷雨
zh.description: 气象员用来判断雷暴的 Skew-T 探空图，现在按你的园地位置直接画出来。它把天气模型的高空数据整理成水汽、不稳定度和触发条件三要素，加上逐小时风险条，帮你判断下午是短阵雨还是真正的风暴。还有一整套入门指南，教你一步一步看懂这张图。
features: 按定位或园地画出 Skew-T 探空图
多个天气模型可切换比较
CAPE 和不稳定指数，判断雷暴强弱
逐小时风险条和降雨量估算
图解入门指南，从零开始学看探空图

en.tagline: Vertical atmosphere profile: will a storm build today?
en.description: The Skew-T sounding that forecasters use to judge thunderstorms, drawn for your own farm's location. It turns weather-model data from the upper air into the three storm ingredients (moisture, instability and a trigger) plus an hourly risk strip, so you can tell a quick afternoon shower from a real storm. A step-by-step guide teaches you how to read the chart.
features: Skew-T sounding for your location or saved farms
Switch between several weather models
CAPE and instability indices for storm strength
Hourly risk strip and rain amount estimate
Illustrated beginner's guide to reading soundings

ms.tagline: Profil menegak atmosfera: adakah ribut akan terbentuk hari ini?
ms.description: Carta Skew-T yang digunakan oleh ahli meteorologi untuk menilai ribut petir, dilukis untuk lokasi kebun anda sendiri. Ia menukar data model cuaca di udara atas kepada tiga bahan ribut (lembapan, ketidakstabilan dan pencetus) serta jalur risiko setiap jam, supaya anda boleh bezakan hujan sekejap petang dengan ribut sebenar. Panduan langkah demi langkah mengajar cara membaca carta ini.
features: Carta Skew-T untuk lokasi anda atau kebun yang disimpan
Tukar antara beberapa model cuaca
CAPE dan indeks ketidakstabilan untuk kekuatan ribut
Jalur risiko setiap jam dan anggaran jumlah hujan
Panduan bergambar untuk pemula membaca carta

author: stanley

zh.tagline: 用 NASA 卫星数据管理榴莲园：土壤水分、催花和灌溉
zh.description: 输入园地位置，TerraDurian 就会拉取 NASA 的卫星和气候数据（POWER、MODIS、GIBS），通过 Cloudflare Worker 读取真实的 SMAP 卫星土壤水分，再加上 ERA5-Land、SoilGrids 土壤和 16 天天气预报。它算出这块地种榴莲的适合度，看根区水分压力是否足够催花并推算收成，按 FAO-56 方法算出每棵树每天要灌多少水。另有坡度和排水判断（Copernicus 地形）、和 10 年平均比较的气候基线、NASA 卫星图和火点图层，以及多块地的比较。数据来源都在「来源」页写清楚；非 NASA 的资料会标出来。三语界面，有浅色和深色模式，可装到手机离线打开。
features: 榴莲种植适合度评分
根区水分压力：催花信号和收成推算，可对照真实 SMAP 卫星数据
FAO-56 水分平衡：每棵树每天和每周的灌溉量
坡度、排水和土壤：防疫霉病的选地判断
10 年气候基线、16 天预报和 NASA 卫星图
多块地比较，可导出导入

en.tagline: NASA satellite data for durian farms: soil moisture, flowering and irrigation
en.description: Enter your farm's location and TerraDurian pulls NASA satellite and climate data (POWER, MODIS, GIBS), live SMAP soil moisture through a Cloudflare Worker, ERA5-Land, SoilGrids soil data and a 16-day forecast. It scores how suitable the site is for durian, checks whether root-zone water stress is enough to trigger flowering and projects the harvest, and works out litres per tree per day with the FAO-56 method. It also judges slope and drainage from Copernicus terrain data, compares this year with the 10-year normal, shows NASA imagery with an active-fires overlay, and lets you save and compare several plots. A Sources tab says where every number comes from, and non-NASA data is labelled. Three languages, light and dark themes, and it installs on the phone and opens offline.
features: Durian site suitability score
Root-zone water stress: flowering signal and harvest projection, checked against live SMAP
FAO-56 water balance: litres per tree per day and per week
Slope, drainage and soil: siting against Phytophthora
10-year climate baseline, 16-day forecast and NASA imagery
Save and compare plots, with export and import

ms.tagline: Data satelit NASA untuk kebun durian: kelembapan tanah, pembungaan dan pengairan
ms.description: Masukkan lokasi kebun dan TerraDurian akan menarik data satelit dan iklim NASA (POWER, MODIS, GIBS), kelembapan tanah SMAP sebenar melalui Cloudflare Worker, ERA5-Land, data tanah SoilGrids dan ramalan 16 hari. Ia memberi skor kesesuaian tapak untuk durian, menyemak sama ada tekanan air di zon akar cukup untuk merangsang pembungaan dan mengunjur tuaian, serta mengira liter setiap pokok sehari dengan kaedah FAO-56. Ia juga menilai cerun dan saliran daripada data rupa bumi Copernicus, membandingkan tahun ini dengan purata 10 tahun, menunjukkan imej NASA dengan lapisan kebakaran aktif, dan membolehkan beberapa plot disimpan dan dibandingkan. Tab Sumber menerangkan asal setiap angka, dan data bukan NASA dilabelkan. Tiga bahasa, tema cerah dan gelap, dan boleh dipasang pada telefon serta dibuka tanpa internet.
features: Skor kesesuaian tapak untuk durian
Tekanan air zon akar: isyarat pembungaan dan unjuran tuaian, disemak dengan SMAP sebenar
Imbangan air FAO-56: liter setiap pokok sehari dan seminggu
Cerun, saliran dan tanah: pemilihan tapak untuk elak Phytophthora
Garis dasar iklim 10 tahun, ramalan 16 hari dan imej NASA
Simpan dan banding plot, dengan eksport dan import

zh.tagline: 榴莲蛀干小蠹：辨认、分级、处理、排时间表
zh.description: 树干上的小洞有好几种，处理方法完全不同，认错了就白花钱。这个 App 先教你分清小蠹（针孔）、天牛和疫霉病，再按洞的数量和树皮状况给树分级，然后列出该怎么处理和喷药时间表。它也解释为什么内吸药对小蠹没用、为什么不建议用酒精诱捕器。
features: 辨认针孔小蠹、天牛和疫霉病
看洞数和树皮给树分级
按等级给出处理方案
喷药和巡园时间表
附上研究来源

en.tagline: Durian pinhole borer: identify, grade, act, schedule
en.description: Holes in the trunk come from different causes that need completely different treatment, and getting it wrong wastes money. This app first helps you tell pinhole borers (ambrosia beetles) from longhorn beetles and Phytophthora, then grades the tree by hole count and bark condition, and gives an action plan and spray schedule. It also explains why systemic insecticides do nothing against this beetle and why alcohol traps are not used.
features: Tell pinhole borer, longhorn beetle and Phytophthora apart
Grade the tree by hole count and bark condition
Action plan for each grade
Spray and patrol schedule
Research sources included

ms.name: Kumbang Pengorek Durian
ms.tagline: Pengorek lubang jarum durian: kenal pasti, gred, tindakan, jadual
ms.description: Lubang pada batang datang daripada punca berbeza yang perlukan rawatan yang sama sekali berbeza, dan silap kenal membazir wang. Aplikasi ini mula-mula bantu anda bezakan pengorek lubang jarum (kumbang ambrosia), kumbang tanduk panjang dan Phytophthora, kemudian beri gred pokok mengikut bilangan lubang dan keadaan kulit kayu, serta pelan tindakan dan jadual semburan. Ia juga terangkan kenapa racun sistemik tidak berkesan untuk kumbang ini dan kenapa perangkap alkohol tidak digunakan.
features: Bezakan pengorek lubang jarum, kumbang tanduk panjang dan Phytophthora
Gred pokok mengikut bilangan lubang dan keadaan kulit kayu
Pelan tindakan untuk setiap gred
Jadual semburan dan rondaan
Sumber kajian disertakan

zh.tagline: 疫霉、回枯、镰刀菌还是根病？勾选看到的症状
zh.description: 榴莲树干上的四种病看起来很像，处理方法却完全不同。你只要勾选树上真的看得到的症状（流胶、小黑点、白色霉、整棵树枯萎），App 就会指出最可能是哪一种病。另外还有杀菌剂和抗药性说明、有益微生物、果腐和田间记录。整个 App 离线也能用。
features: 勾选看得到的症状，找出最可能的病
疫霉、葡萄座腔菌回枯、镰刀菌、根病四种对比
先排除不是病的情况，不乱喷药
杀菌剂选择和抗药性管理
完全离线可用

en.tagline: Phytophthora, dieback, Fusarium or root disease? Tick what you see
en.description: The four durian trunk diseases look alike but need entirely different handling. Tick only the symptoms you can actually see on the tree (weeping gum, black dots, white mould, a wilting tree with a clean trunk) and the app points to the most likely disease. It also covers fungicides and resistance management, beneficial microbes, fruit rot and a field log. Works fully offline.
features: Tick visible symptoms to find the most likely disease
Compares Phytophthora, Botryosphaeriaceae dieback, Fusarium and root disease
Rule out non-disease causes first, so you don't spray for nothing
Fungicide choice and resistance management
Works fully offline

ms.name: Kenal Pasti Penyakit Batang Durian
ms.tagline: Phytophthora, mati rosot, Fusarium atau penyakit akar? Tandakan apa yang anda nampak
ms.description: Empat penyakit batang durian nampak serupa tetapi perlukan rawatan yang sama sekali berbeza. Tandakan hanya simptom yang betul-betul anda nampak pada pokok (gam meleleh, bintik hitam, kulat putih, pokok layu dengan batang yang bersih) dan aplikasi akan tunjuk penyakit yang paling mungkin. Ia juga merangkumi racun kulat dan pengurusan kerintangan, mikrob berfaedah, reput buah dan rekod ladang. Boleh digunakan sepenuhnya tanpa internet.
features: Tandakan simptom yang nampak untuk cari penyakit paling mungkin
Bandingkan Phytophthora, mati rosot Botryosphaeriaceae, Fusarium dan penyakit akar
Tolak dulu punca yang bukan penyakit, supaya tidak sembur sia-sia
Pilihan racun kulat dan pengurusan kerintangan
Boleh digunakan sepenuhnya tanpa internet

zh.tagline: 昆虫看到什么颜色？选对黄板和诱虫灯
zh.description: 为什么黄板能粘到蚜虫和粉虱，诱虫灯却吸引另一批虫？InsectEye 让你拖动颜色条，看每个波长对昆虫眼睛的作用，以及哪些害虫有记录的反应。按你要对付的害虫和目的（监测还是大量诱杀），它会推荐合适的诱捕方式，还告诉你黏板多久要换，以及榴莲园和菜园各生长期的用法。
features: 拖动颜色条，看昆虫对各波长的反应
按害虫和目的推荐黄板或诱虫灯
什么时候该换黏板
榴莲园和菜园各阶段的用法
每项都标明证据来源和等级

en.tagline: What colours do insects see? Pick the right sticky card or light trap
en.description: Why does a yellow card catch aphids and whiteflies while a light trap pulls in a different crowd? InsectEye lets you drag a colour bar to see how each wavelength affects insect eyes and which pests have a documented response. Choose the pest and your goal (monitoring or mass trapping) and it recommends a trap, tells you when to replace cards, and shows how to use them at each stage of a durian orchard or vegetable plot.
features: Drag the colour bar to see insect response by wavelength
Card or lamp recommendation by pest and goal
When to replace sticky cards
Use by growth stage for durian and vegetables
Every claim labelled with its evidence and source

en.description: Manages basal stem rot (BSR) caused by Ganoderma boninense in oil palm and coconut. Score a palm 0–4 (Healthy, Early, Moderate, Severe, Dead) from four observations, then build a dated multi-batch plan for its stage: sanitation, soil mounding, Trichoderma, bacterial drench, AMF, EFB compost and census dates. It warns when a Trichoderma batch falls within 28 days of a hexaconazole trunk injection. It turns the plan into a Trichoderma rice-grain brewing schedule, records block censuses with disease incidence, DSI and AUDPC, and compares treated and control blocks. The Evidence tab summarises the published research and where to buy products in Malaysia. Biocontrol prevents and slows BSR; no study has cured an established infection in a mature palm. Plan amounts and intervals are planning assumptions, so follow product labels and MPOB advice.

en.tagline: Soil organic matter and humic substances: what they are, whether they help, how to build them
en.description: Explains what soil organic matter is and how current science sees it: microbes break down and rebuild leaves and dead roots, and how long organic matter lasts depends mainly on whether microbes can reach it and whether clay protects it. Humic acid, fulvic acid and humin are three fractions sorted by solubility, not three fixed molecules. The app compares fulvic and humic acid, rates the evidence behind each trial, answers "should I buy a humic product?" from your soil and tree condition, and shows how to read a label and check solubility at home. The Build section covers keeping the ground under the trees covered, which materials to use, how much to apply to durian at each stage by tree age, and the link between organic matter and durian Phytophthora. The Check section judges organic matter in two minutes from three observations, with no tools.

en.tagline: Soil science: a field guide, site tools and plot records
en.description: Seven units in the order the work is done in the field: know your soil, soil properties, reading a site (sampling, Malaysian soils, peat and acid sulfate soils), protecting soil, improving soil, feeding crops, then oil palm, selected fruit trees and paddy. Each unit ends with a practical activity and a quiz. Five tools: the USDA soil texture triangle (with jar-test input), a soil pH explorer with guide ranges per crop (it gives no lime rate, which needs a laboratory test), a slope calculator, a nutrient deficiency key, and a fertiliser calculator (straight, compound, per plant, tree programme, bag contents and cost). Tool results can be saved to per-plot records that total nutrients and cost by plot and year, with CSV export and backup. Search and a glossary work in all three languages. Numbers in the lessons are teaching examples; real lime and fertiliser recommendations should come from a soil test and an agriculture officer.

ms.name: Sains Tanah
ms.tagline: Sains tanah: panduan lapangan, alat di tapak dan rekod plot
ms.description: Tujuh unit mengikut urutan kerja di lapangan: kenali tanah, sifat tanah, membaca tapak (persampelan, tanah Malaysia, tanah gambut dan tanah sulfat masam), melindungi tanah, memperbaiki tanah, membaja tanaman, serta sawit, beberapa pokok buah dan padi. Angka dalam pelajaran ialah contoh pengajaran; cadangan kapur dan baja sebenar perlu berdasarkan ujian tanah dan nasihat pegawai pertanian.

zh.tagline: MET Malaysia 对 ECMWF：哪个预报在你的园地更准？
zh.description: 每天记录马来西亚气象局（MET Malaysia）和 ECMWF 对你园地的降雨预报，等实际雨量（ERA5）回填后逐日对比打分，用 CSI、命中率（POD）、空报率（FAR）和偏差告诉你哪一个比较可信。内置 114 个地点，服务器每天早上自动记录预报，打开 App 就会补入；自己新增的地点要每天打开记录一次。显示未来 3 天两边的预报，MET 还分早上、下午、晚上三个时段。可看逐日对照、走势和跨农场排名，导出 Excel，分享到 WhatsApp。这是长期实验：实测雨量约 5 天后才回填，最快第 5–6 天才有第一个分数，约 2 周后才有参考价值，3 周后才够可信。

en.tagline: MET Malaysia vs ECMWF: which forecast is right for your farm?
en.description: Logs MET Malaysia's and ECMWF's rain forecasts for your farm every day, then scores them day by day once actual rain (ERA5) is backfilled, using CSI, hit rate (POD), false alarm ratio (FAR) and bias to show which one to trust. 114 farms are built in and the server logs their forecasts every morning, added when you open the app; farms you add yourself need the app opened once a day. It shows both forecasts for the next 3 days, with MET split into morning, afternoon and night. There is a day-by-day table, a trend, a cross-farm ranking, Excel export and WhatsApp sharing. It is a long-term experiment: actual rain arrives about 5 days later, so the first score appears on day 5–6 at the earliest, becomes indicative after about 2 weeks and trustworthy after about 3.

Scored on ERA5 actual rain: CSI, POD, FAR, bias

ms.tagline: MET Malaysia lawan ECMWF: ramalan mana lebih tepat untuk kebun anda?
ms.description: Merekod ramalan hujan MET Malaysia dan ECMWF untuk kebun anda setiap hari, kemudian memberi skor hari demi hari apabila hujan sebenar (ERA5) diisi, menggunakan CSI, kadar kena (POD), nisbah amaran palsu (FAR) dan bias untuk menunjukkan yang mana boleh dipercayai. 114 kebun sudah terbina dan pelayan merekod ramalannya setiap pagi, ditambah apabila anda membuka app; kebun yang anda tambah sendiri perlu dibuka sekali sehari. Ia menunjukkan kedua-dua ramalan untuk 3 hari akan datang, dengan MET dibahagi kepada pagi, petang dan malam. Turut ada jadual hari demi hari, trend, kedudukan antara kebun, eksport Excel dan kongsi WhatsApp. Ini eksperimen jangka panjang: hujan sebenar diisi kira-kira 5 hari kemudian, jadi skor pertama paling awal pada hari ke-5–6, menjadi panduan selepas kira-kira 2 minggu dan boleh dipercayai selepas kira-kira 3 minggu.

Skor berdasarkan hujan sebenar ERA5: CSI, POD, FAR, bias

3 hari akan datang, dengan tempoh pagi, petang dan malam MET
Jadual hari demi hari, trend dan kedudukan antara kebun
Eksport Excel dan kongsi WhatsApp

zh.tagline: 敲一敲听声辨熟：拿自然落果的声音做基准
zh.description: 用手机麦克风听敲榴莲的声音来判断熟度的田间实验工具。先收集约 10 粒自己园里自然掉落的榴莲（当作 100% 树上熟），用同一件硬物（例如汤匙柄）敲，录进基准库；之后敲树上还没掉的果，app 只分析敲击后约 250 毫秒的低频共振（果肉和空腔的声音），和落果基准比较，给出「约 X–Y% 接近熟」和信心度。鸟叫和风声大多会被过滤，摩托车或人声会降低信心度，可以重录。app 自己写明：它不测干物质或糖度，信心低时会说「不确定」，不会硬给数字；真正的判断还是要靠切开、闻香和自然落果。
features: 用自己园里的自然落果做「熟」的基准
敲击后自动判断，有把握就自动停止
只分析低频共振，过滤大部分鸟叫和风声

en.tagline: Tap and listen for ripeness, measured against your own dropped fruit
en.description: A field-experiment tool that uses the phone's microphone to judge durian ripeness from the sound of a knock. First collect about 10 naturally-dropped durians from your own trees (treated as 100% tree-ripe), tap each with the same hard object such as a spoon handle, and record them into the baseline. Then tap a fruit still on the tree: the app analyses only the low-frequency resonance in the ~250 ms after the hit (the flesh and cavity sound), compares it with the drop-fruit baseline, and gives "≈ X–Y% toward ripe" with a confidence level. Most birdsong and wind are filtered out; a motorbike or a shout lowers confidence and you can re-record. The app is open about its limits: it does not measure dry matter or sugar, says "unsure" rather than inventing a number, and the real call still comes from cutting, aroma and natural drop.
features: Your own naturally-dropped fruit as the "ripe" baseline
Judges as it listens and stops once confident
Low-frequency analysis that filters most birdsong and wind
Range toward ripe with a confidence level, or "unsure"
Adjustable tap sensitivity

ms.name: Bunyi Durian
ms.tagline: Ketuk dan dengar kematangan, berbanding buah gugur anda sendiri
ms.description: Alat ujian kebun yang menggunakan mikrofon telefon untuk menilai kematangan durian daripada bunyi ketukan. Mula-mula kumpul kira-kira 10 biji durian yang gugur sendiri dari pokok anda (dianggap 100% masak di pokok), ketuk setiap satu dengan objek keras yang sama seperti hulu sudu, dan rakam ke dalam rujukan. Kemudian ketuk buah yang masih di pokok: app hanya menganalisis resonans frekuensi rendah dalam ~250 ms selepas ketukan (bunyi isi dan rongga), membandingkannya dengan rujukan buah gugur, dan memberi "≈ X–Y% ke arah masak" bersama tahap keyakinan. Kebanyakan bunyi burung dan angin ditapis; bunyi motosikal atau jeritan menurunkan keyakinan dan anda boleh merakam semula. App ini jujur tentang hadnya: ia tidak mengukur bahan kering atau gula, menyatakan "tidak pasti" dan bukannya mereka angka, dan keputusan sebenar tetap bergantung pada membelah buah, bau dan gugur semula jadi.
features: Buah gugur anda sendiri sebagai rujukan "masak"
Menilai sambil mendengar dan berhenti apabila yakin
Analisis frekuensi rendah yang menapis kebanyakan bunyi burung dan angin
Julat ke arah masak dengan tahap keyakinan, atau "tidak pasti"
Kepekaan ketukan boleh dilaras

zh.tagline: 树熟还是割果？按品种和开花日期算出割果时机
zh.description: 帮榴梿园主决定什么时候割果。选品种、填开花日期（超过 70% 花开的那天），再选采收方式、割果时的成熟度（85%、90% 或 95%）和销往哪里（本地、短途、长途出口），就算出预计割果日期，并给出建议的采收线，以及大约的风味、常温和冷链保存天数。「我的果园」可以用自己的树号（方便配合 MyGAP／MyLadang 溯源）登记每棵树的开花和落果日期，几季之后就能算出那棵树自己的落果天数，可导出导入 Excel（CSV）。「数据洞察」把记录画成图，包括采收高峰的人手安排。「成熟科学」讲榴梿是呼吸跃变型水果、2026 年的「榴梿海啸」、各种出口方式，以及农业局 2026 年的割果指引。app 不替你决定割不割；日期和数字都是估算，割之前还要看果上的成熟迹象。

en.tagline: Tree-drop or cut? Work out the cut date from the variety and flowering date
en.description: Helps durian growers decide when to cut. Pick the variety, enter the flowering date (the day more than 70% of flowers were open), then choose how you harvest, how ripe to cut (85%, 90% or 95%) and where the fruit is going (local, short-haul or long-haul export). It gives an estimated cut window and a recommended harvest line, with the expected flavour and roughly how many days the fruit keeps at room temperature and in a cold chain. My Farms logs each tree's flowering and drop dates under your own tree IDs (to line up with MyGAP / MyLadang traceability), so within a few seasons you get that tree's own drop timing; data exports and imports as Excel (CSV). Insights turns the records into charts, including the upcoming harvest load for labour planning. The Science tab explains why durian is a climacteric fruit, the 2026 "durian tsunami", export routes and the Malaysian DOA cut-harvest guideline (2026). The app does not decide for you; dates and figures are estimates, so check the signs on the fruit before cutting.
features: Cut window from variety and flowering date
Recommended harvest line by market, with flavour and shelf life
Per-tree flowering and drop log that calibrates your own timing
Excel (CSV) export and import
Charts of harvest load and records across seasons

ms.name: Sains Pemasakan Durian
ms.tagline: Gugur atau potong? Kira tarikh potong daripada varieti dan tarikh berbunga
ms.description: Membantu pekebun durian memutuskan bila hendak memotong buah. Pilih varieti, masukkan tarikh berbunga (hari lebih 70% bunga kembang), kemudian pilih cara tuaian, tahap kematangan semasa dipotong (85%, 90% atau 95%) dan destinasi buah (tempatan, jarak dekat atau eksport jarak jauh). App memberi anggaran tempoh potong dan laluan tuaian yang disyorkan, bersama jangkaan rasa dan anggaran berapa hari buah tahan pada suhu bilik dan dalam rantaian sejuk. Kebun Saya merekod tarikh berbunga dan gugur setiap pokok mengikut nombor pokok anda sendiri (selari dengan kebolehkesanan MyGAP / MyLadang), jadi dalam beberapa musim anda mendapat masa gugur pokok itu sendiri; data boleh dieksport dan diimport sebagai Excel (CSV). Analisis menukar rekod kepada carta, termasuk beban tuaian akan datang untuk merancang tenaga kerja. Tab Sains menerangkan mengapa durian buah klimakterik, "tsunami durian" 2026, laluan eksport dan garis panduan penuaian durian potong Jabatan Pertanian (2026). App tidak membuat keputusan untuk anda; tarikh dan angka ialah anggaran, jadi periksa tanda pada buah sebelum memotong.
features: Tempoh potong daripada varieti dan tarikh berbunga

en.tagline: Record your orchard's GPS location and send it to Stanley Woo on WhatsApp
en.description: Stand in the orchard and tap once to read the latitude, longitude, position accuracy and elevation (the phone's GPS altitude when it is accurate to 15 m or better, otherwise a map estimate from Open-Meteo). Check the spot on a satellite map; if GPS is poor, drag the pin or tap the map to the right place and lock it. Enter the farmer's name and a location name (Chinese, or English/Malay, at least one). The app first shows the WhatsApp message so you can edit it, then opens WhatsApp to Stanley Woo, and you tap Send yourself. It opens without internet; sending and the satellite map need a connection, and unsent details are kept on the phone. The coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for the elevation lookup and map tiles come from Esri; nothing is stored on a server.

ms.tagline: Rekod lokasi GPS dusun anda dan hantar kepada Stanley Woo melalui WhatsApp
ms.description: Berdiri di dalam dusun dan tekan sekali untuk membaca latitud, longitud, ketepatan kedudukan dan ketinggian (ketinggian GPS telefon jika tepat hingga 15 m atau lebih baik, jika tidak anggaran peta daripada Open-Meteo). zh.tagline: 该不该买喷药无人机？对比自购、人工喷洒和外包

en.tagline: Should you buy a spraying drone? Compare owning one with manual spraying and outsourcing
en.description: Enter your farm, equipment, operations and costs, and DroneInvest works out the annual cost of owning a drone, spraying by hand and outsourcing, plus the upfront cash, a monthly payback that includes battery and equipment replacements, five-year net savings and discounted savings. It finds the number of rounds and the outsourcing price at which the options break even, and checks whether one drone and crew have the capacity. Conservative, base and optimistic cases and a one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis show how the result moves; every input can be marked verified, and missing data is listed rather than quietly treated as zero. Save several plans, export JSON and a monthly cash-flow CSV, or print the investment report. Amounts are in ringgit; the sample figures are illustrative, not supplier quotes or a purchase recommendation. Data stays in your browser and it works offline.

ms.tagline: Patutkah anda beli dron semburan? Bandingkan memiliki dron dengan semburan manual dan upah luar
ms.description: Masukkan butiran ladang, peralatan, operasi dan kos, dan DroneInvest mengira kos tahunan memiliki dron, menyembur secara manual dan mengupah pihak luar, serta modal awal, tempoh pulang modal bulanan yang mengambil kira penggantian bateri dan peralatan, penjimatan bersih 5 tahun dan penjimatan terdiskaun. Ia mencari bilangan pusingan dan harga upah luar pada titik pulang modal, serta menyemak sama ada satu dron dan krew cukup kapasiti. Senario konservatif, asas dan optimistik serta analisis kepekaan satu demi satu menunjukkan bagaimana keputusan berubah; setiap input boleh ditanda disahkan, dan data yang tiada disenaraikan, bukan dianggap sifar secara senyap. Amaun dalam ringgit; angka contoh hanyalah anggaran, bukan sebut harga pembekal atau cadangan pembelian. Data kekal dalam pelayar anda dan boleh digunakan tanpa internet.
